mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signup_requests (email, name, reason, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{name}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM signup_requests WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE signup_requests SET status = #{status}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, processed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
